investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Zephyris Travel (travel booking); Platform: Microsoft Azure uksouth (zones uksouth-1/uksouth-2/uksouth-3); network range 10.59.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster zephyr-prod-uksout (AKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic ancillaries-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer ancillaries-svc, consumer search-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
